allocation_complete.reason: The element has no allocates link.

completeness.reason: Percent display with 1 % resolution and the km range from the last-50-km average consumption are only covered implicitly by 'derives the remaining range'.
completeness.suggestion: Add the 1 % resolution / percent scaling and the last-50-km consumption basis to the element.

consistency.reason: Consistent with siblings BB_ENERGY_STATE (BMS provides the SoC) and, in diesel, ARCH_ENG_FUEL_LEVEL (provides fuel level to the VCU).

design_clarity.reason: Names the component and the data flow (energy source -> VCU -> instrument cluster) but not the range derivation (50 km consumption window, consumption memory) nor the signal/interface used to read the SoC or fuel level.
design_clarity.suggestion: State how the range is derived (rolling 50 km consumption average kept in the VCU) and name the input signal (BMS SoC message / ENG fuel level) and output to the cluster.

implementability.reason: One bounded VCU component; the energy source is fixed per product and the calculation is fixed by the parent requirement.

interface_only.reason: The element has no allocates link.

no_value_copy.reason: No BMS value (limit, threshold, timing) is named.

parent_fit.reason: Reads the remaining energy from the product's energy source and derives/sends the range to the cluster, engaging both REQ_ENERGY_SOURCE and REQ_RANGE_ESTIMATE.

variant_consistency.reason: Ungated, like both parents: REQ_RANGE_ESTIMATE is ungated and REQ_ENERGY_SOURCE exists in every product (BEV/diesel alternatives).
